code_review_summary: none found. Read all of crosssection_linear.R (228 lines) and funs_and_constants.R (58 lines); other deposited scripts were not reviewed line by line.
env_fixes: diffs/crosssection_linear.R.diff: library(specr) commented out for the main run (specr not yet installed then; no specr function is called in the script; after specr 1.0.0 was installed the unmodified script gave identical results, see outputs/specr_check.txt); both marginaleffects plot blocks wrapped in try() (PREREG step 4). No model or data line changed.
Data placed as data/epro_data_h1.csv, data/epro_data_h2.csv, data/epro_geo_data_h3.csv via ?format=original (deposit is flat, code reads data/). Path-only, no file edit.

Packages: fixest 0.11.1 (authors' pin) and texreg 1.38.6 (authors' pin) built from the CRAN archive into a fresh library; dplyr 1.0.9 and vctrs 0.5.1 (authors' pins) built but could not be loaded with the rest of the installed stack (see LOG.md), so system dplyr 1.1.4 / vctrs 0.6.5 were used.
class_reason: All five Table 1 targets reproduce to the printed rounding with the authors' pinned fixest 0.11.1, with significance bands matching the printed stars; the factor reference level is 'Both' as in the paper.
confidence_reason: Deterministic OLS; data checksums match PREREG; pinned fixest and texreg used; numbers parsed by script from coeftable output.
uncertainties: dplyr 1.0.9 / vctrs 0.5.1 pins were not usable together with the system tidyverse stack (vctrs 0.5.1: 'namespace vctrs 0.5.1 is already loaded, but >= 0.6.0 is required'; dplyr 1.0.9: broom.mixed needs dplyr >= 1.0.10). The factor level order (Both, None, Single) came from dplyr 1.1.4 / vctrs 0.6.5; whether the authors' dplyr 1.0.9 gives the same order was not run, but the paper's printed baseline 'Both' matches.
Model 2 category counts in mean_h1 (all 139 groups, before the one missing-covariate drop): Both 40, None 25, Single 74 (outputs/factor_levels.csv).
R_c (no country fixed effects) gives a smaller T1 coefficient 0.1482 with p 0.143: the H1 association in the pooled model is not significant at 0.05 (robustness only, does not change the class).

Context check, not pre-registered as a check (PREREG section 1 notes that p. 824 prose says a min-to-max change predicts a 0.2 point increase, Figure 2 left panel, while Table 1 Model 1 prints 0.51). The Figure 2 left-panel model in the code dichotomises the predictor (Both vs None/Single): Model 1 coef resource_and_agriculture (min 0 to max 1 change) = 0.5065; full_model_h1_graph coef resource_and_agricultureNone/Single (Figure 2 left panel model) = -0.2197; Model 3 coef resource_and_agriculture = 0.1907; range of resource_and_agriculture in estimation sample (min|max) = 0|1 (outputs/figure2_prose_check.csv). So the 0.2 in the prose is close in size to the Both vs None/Single gap of the dichotomised Figure 2 model, not to the Model 1 coefficient. Described, not judged.
